floating_image_exceptions.reason: Uses the official nginx Alpine channel for the lightweight static gateway helper; runtime hardening is enforced by readonly template, healthcheck, and nginx config validation.
floating_image_exceptions.risk: Channel tags may change content without a tag change; updates require manual review and rollback identity capture.
floating_image_exceptions.exit_condition: Replace with a supported immutable tag plus digest after compatibility and recovery verification.

floating_image_exceptions.reason: Existing GPU-specific third-party image channel retained for required HOME image workflows while CUDA compatibility and rebuild provenance are evaluated.
floating_image_exceptions.risk: Mutable channel and third-party image; GPU/client compatibility and rollback digest must be reviewed before pulls.
floating_image_exceptions.exit_condition: Migrate to a verified maintained build or immutable digest after GTX 1060 compatibility, model persistence and restore rehearsal.

floating_image_exceptions.reason: Open Notebook's approved compatibility boundary is SurrealDB v2; the Dockerfile copies the surreal binary from the v2 channel (infra/08-ai/open-notebook/README.md, Database Compatibility).
floating_image_exceptions.risk: The v2 channel can move to a new patch without a tag change, so the copied binary is not reproducible and no digest identifies a rollback.
floating_image_exceptions.exit_condition: Pin an exact v2 patch tag plus digest after Open Notebook compatibility and data checks, or move to v3 under a separate approved change.

floating_image_exceptions.reason: Runtime base of the SurrealDB image built for Open Notebook; it supplies ca-certificates and bash around the copied binary.
floating_image_exceptions.risk: The bookworm-slim channel receives point releases and security rebuilds without a tag change, so rebuilds are not reproducible.
floating_image_exceptions.exit_condition: Pin a dated bookworm-slim tag plus digest when the SurrealDB build is pinned.
